"use client";

import { HStack, Separator, Stack, Text } from "@chakra-ui/react"

export const SeparatorWithLabel = () => {
  return (
    <Stack>
      <HStack>
        <Text flexShrink="0">Label (start)</Text>
        <Separator flex="1" />
      </HStack>

      <HStack>
        <Separator flex="1" />
        <Text flexShrink="0">Label (end)</Text>
      </HStack>

      <HStack>
        <Separator flex="1" />
        <Text flexShrink="0">Label (center)</Text>
        <Separator flex="1" />
      </HStack>
    </Stack>
  )
}

# Chakra UI Separator

Visually separate related areas of an interface.

## Installation

- Complete MIT examples with a ChakraProvider using defaultSystem.
- Reuse the application-level ChakraProvider when integrating; keep HiddenInput in checkbox and switch compositions for keyboard and form semantics.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
